subject_intro: The average interest rates UK banks and building societies are advertising on easy access savings, fixed-rate bonds and cash ISAs, updated monthly from Bank of England data.
subject_meta_title: Average UK Savings Rates: Easy Access, Fixed Bonds and Cash ISAs
subject_meta_description: The latest Bank of England averages for UK savings rates: easy access accounts, 1, 2 and 3-year fixed-rate bonds, and cash ISAs.
context: Savings rates tend to follow the Bank of England's base rate, though banks don't always pass changes on in full.
